spec: THEOREM-PROJECTS-SIDEBAR-AND-SESSION-GRAPH-SPEC.md (attached by the owner in chat, 2026-11-14; not yet in a repository)

items.requirement: Default sidebar has Pinned, Projects, Chats and visible Search; the activity sections are absent
evidence: src/components/organize/organized-panel.tsx
Rendered: /story/organized-sidebar and /story/project-home, light and dark, 1280 and 1440 wide

items.requirement: Replies, prompt edits and regenerations add zero session rows
evidence: nestingSource and nestByOrigin in src/lib/theorem/organization.ts, tested in organization.test.ts
thread-row.tsx draws no version-branch rows
Not exercised against a live backend: the e2e stack needs rustyred-thg-server and provider keys

items.requirement: An explicit session fork creates one distinct session and its provenance relation
evidence: Forks nest under their source (organization.test.ts)
Fork creation and retry recovery are Theorem's; not exercised live

items.requirement: Explicit child creation nests; continuation-only provenance does not
evidence: Continuations stay at the top level (organization.test.ts)
Theorem records no child-session origin yet

items.requirement: Opening a session keeps the selected conversation version
evidence: src/components/organize/thread-row.tsx

items.requirement: Pin and unpin change only the user's pin preference
evidence: src/lib/theorem/sidebar-prefs.ts with sidebar-prefs.test.ts; distinct from Membership.pinned ('Keep in…')
Stored per browser, not per user, until Theorem serves a pin route

items.requirement: Missing parents, filters or malformed cycles hide no session
evidence: parentsIn in src/lib/theorem/organization.ts, cycle and missing-source tests in organization.test.ts

items.requirement: Project-title navigation and disclosure are separate, usable actions
evidence: ProjectNode in organized-panel.tsx: a link to /projects/$projectId and a separate 'Show/Hide sessions in …' trigger
scripts/e2e/sidebar.mjs updated to the link and disclosure (not run here)
Clicked in /story/project-home: the Platinum link opens Platinum's home

items.requirement: Project navigation, scoped composer, recent sessions, project editing, context and connection summaries (slice B)
evidence: src/components/projects/project-home.tsx, project-edit-dialog.tsx, project-outputs.tsx
Documents, repositories, links and connections are labelled 'Not served yet'; Theorem has no project resource binding

items.requirement: Opening or switching views emits zero domain-changing commands
evidence: projectGraph is pure; session-graph.test.ts checks frozen inputs are unchanged
The React Flow view is not draggable or connectable and has no delete key

items.requirement: Lineage, Team, Related and Tasks lenses over the same records (slice C)
evidence: Lineage and Projects are drawn from Thread.origin and memberships
Delegation, Team and Related say why they are not served; they need relation routes in Theorem

items.requirement: All relationship operations are available without canvas dragging
evidence: 'Show as list' in session-graph.tsx gives every node and relation as text; the inspector lists relations in words

items.requirement: Headings are distinguishable and larger than row labels
evidence: ui.group recipe (600, 15px/20px) in src/lib/appearance-policy.ts and src/appearance.css, against 14px rows

items.requirement: New thread is less prominent while readable
evidence: organized-panel.tsx: regular weight, muted ink

items.requirement: Icon and type changes grant no capability and start no run
evidence: Session types live only in sidebar-prefs.ts and are read only by glyphs.tsx
